description.short_caption: Axial CT scan of the abdomen showing bowel loops and surrounding structures.
description.detailed_description: This axial CT image of the abdomen demonstrates multiple loops of bowel with varying densities. There is evidence of gas within the bowel lumen, and the surrounding soft tissues appear unremarkable. The vertebral body and paraspinal musculature are visible posteriorly. No clear signs of free air or fluid collections are apparent in this image.
visible_findings: vertebral body and paraspinal musculature posteriorly
no obvious free air or fluid collections

description.short_caption: Axial CT scan of the abdomen showing liver and adjacent structures.
description.detailed_description: This is an axial CT scan of the abdomen. The liver occupies the right side of the image, with a heterogeneous appearance suggestive of possible pathology. The gallbladder is visible, and the stomach is seen on the left side. The kidneys are partially visualized posteriorly. The scan appears to be contrast-enhanced, as evidenced by the bright enhancement of vascular structures and organs.
